subject: The truth about what 230+ couples discovered this month
preview_text: This month's numbers are in. The results are insane. You won't believe what couples are planning.
body_paragraphs: Okay, confession time. I just crunched the numbers from this past month. Every date planned, every wishlist saved, every surprise unlocked. The data doesn't lie, and what it's showing is wild.

Couples using SoulPlan planned 3x more dates than the average couple. 92% said it directly improved their connection. But here's the real secret: the couples who saw the biggest spark weren't just planning dates. They were using the Surprise Date Planner feature to completely break their routine. One partner plans, the other gets swept away. No discussion, no 'I dunno, what do you want to do?' Just pure, intentional magic.

That feature is the hack. It takes the mental load off one person and turns planning into an act of love. Looking at the data, the couples who used it at least once this month reported feeling more cherished and excited about their relationship. The routine didn't stand a chance.

Your turn. Open the app right now and tap 'Plan a Surprise'. Pick a day this week, let the AI suggest something perfect, and just send the invite to your partner. Watch what happens. P.S. The most popular surprise this month? A mid-week 'memory lane' date revisiting their first spot. Simple, free, and apparently unforgettable.
